Title: General availability: Azure SQL Database geo-replication enhancements

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Database geo-replication includes a set of new features that improve programming and management capabilities for business continuity and disaster recovery scenarios. These enhancements are available for V12 databases, and they include:
  • T-SQL syntax for geo-replication
  • Failover and failback
  • Ability to synchronize security credentials and firewall rules
  • Full support of geo-replication for databases in elastic pools
  • Configurable performance levels of the secondary database
  • Azure Resource Manager API and support of role-based security
  • Synchronous PowerShell cmdlets
For more details, please refer to Spotlight on new capabilities of SQL Database geo-replication.
